reason: sha256:c34f158b9d3a6703006094fc0ac3f50bdf8a8f96665ec161ac5398958f51186e: the recorded verification for pass 2 is host-refusal (kind 'host-refusal'): 'Assembly refused unaccepted dependencies; verification unavailable. Inspect preserved child results.' No checker outcome exists and no critic objection was issued. The only preserved child result (result_ref c0001, template evidence_read, status 'unaccepted', output_status 'partial') contains a full C1-C8 analysis with every required label (INPUT_QUOTE, CANDIDATE_MEANINGS with EVIDENCE_LINES and WOULD_SETTLE, WORKING_READING, CONFIDENCE_AND_ALTERNATIVES, CONFORMANCE_BEFORE_ACTION, PROHIBITED_PRECONFIRMATION_ACTION) and a RUN_CONTROL section, and its quotes carry byte locators against UC3-cases. So usable partial content exists, but nothing establishes that the eight analyses meet the source-grounding obligations. Three concrete defects in the partial output warrant a changed pass rather than acceptance: (1) the byte locators (C1 bytes:224:291 through C8 bytes:999:1061, plus preamble bytes:29:187) were produced by the child's self-report and were never confirmed by a host read of UC3-cases; (2) the child's RUN_CONTROL is explicitly a provisional pre-verification proposal and asserts that no earlier control decisions are available to quote, which must be resolved against the actual control record; (3) the pass refused as REPEATED_IDENTICAL_PASS (fingerprint 1bd166f3e1aad2d3d17f809b3f137e5b46a9fbfa0fd757aa394a231a3eb6f737, refusal_count 1), so re-issuing the same template mix and subtask input hashes would be refused again. A further pass is useful only because the needed change is concrete and changes the fingerprint: the dependency set that the assembler rejected must be replaced with a fresh, acceptable dependency — not a re-run of the identical input. This decision does not treat the refusal as task exhaustion, does not claim any check passed, and does not treat the host-refusal as a resource stop; it is a distinct instrument failure for this pass.
what_changes_next: Issue one new pass whose only change is the dependency/input set so the assembler can accept it: (a) keep the same required artifact (one human-inspectable Markdown analysis of document UC3-cases, headings ## C1..## C8, with per-case INPUT_QUOTE, CANDIDATE_MEANINGS, WORKING_READING, CONFIDENCE_AND_ALTERNATIVES, CONFORMANCE_BEFORE_ACTION, PROHIBITED_PRECONFIRMATION_ACTION, and RUN_CONTROL with CONTINUATION_DECISION and CONTINUATION_REASON); (b) preserve the exact eight observed inputs verbatim from UC3-cases as the only source bytes, and require the new worker to restate each observed line with its source_id UC3-cases and locator so the host can confirm or correct the spans previously asserted (C1 224:291, C2 323:380, C3 422:494, C4 538:604, C5 643:726, C6 767:836, C7 894:960, C8 999:1061, preamble 29:187); (c) require every EVIDENCE_LINE to be an exact substring of UC3-cases or be marked as a paraphrase of a named line; (d) require the child to state explicitly whether any prior continue_or_stop control decision exists, so the RUN_CONTROL claim about earlier decisions can be checked; (e) do not re-use the rejected dependency reference or the prior subtask input hash. No analysis content is to be edited otherwise; no other template mix is introduced until this fresh result exists and can be verified.
stop_rule: Stop only when host verification for a pass confirms all eight analyses C1-C8 carry the required labels and are source-grounded to UC3-cases (each INPUT_QUOTE and EVIDENCE_LINE resolvable to the sealed document), the run is otherwise complete, and the pilot continue_or_stop control records that verification reference with this reason; OR a recorded guard stops the run (max_calls 300 logical calls or the owner-required max_spend_usd 6.0 default, remaining_calls 297 / remaining_usd 5.987931924 at this decision) — a call/spend ceiling stop is a host resource stop and partial, not task exhaustion; other instrument failures (such as this pass's host-refusal verification) remain separately identified failures and likewise do not by themselves mean task exhaustion.
